texts.facts: It is submitted by counsel for petitioner that petitioner, after serving for 30 years, was superannuated on 30.09.2020. By order dated 13.03.2018, third Kramonnati was sanctioned. However, by order dated 05.10.2019, said order was withdrawn on the ground that petitioner had forgone the promotion to the post of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:5614 Pradhanadhyapak, Middle School. It was also observed that excess payment made to petitioner on account of third Kramonnati be recovered. Daulat Singh Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182358121/ 1 It is submitted by counsel for petitioner that Kramonnati is a separate independent cause of action and has nothing to do with refusal to take any promotion. Thus, the refusal to grant third Kramonnati is bad in law.
